rationale: VERSION 3.0.1 -> 3.1.0: replaced arbitrary canvases, blob sizes, free markers, singleton noise, and partial stamps with five complete linked public profiles.; Added procedural source/core translation, all safe global D4 transforms, inert-color relabeling, structured dot/domino/2x2 distractor groups, and collision-aware placement.; Constructively guarantees one attached red port, its matching green destination port, four in-bounds targets, and exact clear/decoy/red-overwrite behavior.; Replaced eight dishonest, dead, constant, alias, or degenerate axes with one exact observable scene_profile control.; Added strict call validation, complete returned-grid self_check, observe_overrides, canonical profile classification, broad Python rule mirror, deterministic fresh returns, and RULE_HASH pinning.; Added seven focused regression groups, independent before/after 30,000-draw censuses, calibrated negative recombination, and 497-case live Racket parity.
summary: Find the first four-connected blue component, the single red source anchor, and the single green destination anchor. Translate every blue-component cell by the red-to-green vector and paint each in-bounds target cyan, preserving the rest of the input except where cyan overwrites an occupied target cell.
